findings.reason: For wakuren, re.findall numbers are frames but stored as horse_numbers and propagated by select_pace_candidates. A top-level limitation is insufficient for machine consumer identity. Existing test uses frame=horse number, masking divergence.
findings.fix: Record number_kind=frame/horse with explicit frame_numbers for wakuren, preserve in filtering output. Add test with multiple horses in same frame and differing horse/frame numbers.
findings.resolution: Adapter emits wakuren horse_numbers=[], frame_numbers and number_kind=frame; selector prioritizes explicit frame input, legacy fallback read only, emits typed output. Frame metadata tests inspected.
